decisions.proposed_text: Thiếu nữ trong sáng × tuổi nổi loạn
decisions.reason: Thuần tình is an unnecessarily Sino-Vietnamese calque here; 纯情 is more naturally conveyed as trong sáng while preserving the contrast with the rebellious phase.
白银收藏家 is directly and naturally rendered as Nhà sưu tầm bạc.
坚忍的速匠 is acceptably rendered as Bậc thầy tốc độ bền bỉ in this compact title context.
无论几何次拉开帷幕 is poetically but faithfully conveyed as Dẫu màn có mở bao lần.
温泉爱好者 is naturally rendered as Người mê suối nước nóng.
温泉乡顾问 is accurately rendered as Cố vấn làng suối nóng.

decisions.proposed_text: Khoảnh khắc hạnh phúc tột cùng
decisions.reason: Chí phúc is a stiff Sino-Vietnamese calque; 至福 means supreme bliss and is more naturally rendered as hạnh phúc tột cùng.

decisions.proposed_text: Người truy tìm truyền thuyết suối nước nóng bí ẩn
decisions.reason: Bí tuyền is an opaque Sino-Vietnamese calque for 秘汤; the intended hidden/secret hot-spring meaning should be explicit in natural Vietnamese.
挖掘匠人 is accurately and naturally rendered as Bậc thầy khai quật.
喷涌而出的活力 is concisely and accurately rendered as Sinh lực tuôn trào.
